glossary.role: UCE Design Bureau engineer in charge of Ark-series/Gun Ark development; supports Tak and Marina. Spoiler: secretly the son of Albert Rainen and the treacherous mastermind who gave Marina the Buster Ark; fights in the Feather Ark Custom at the end.
glossary.personality: Outwardly a kindly professor-type adviser (sends Tak e-mails); actually vengeful against the UCE for what happened to his father.

glossary.role: MSC-07 Pegasus-class Federation assault carrier commanded by Sinapus.
Latest Ark-series transforming machine from the UCE Design Bureau; Tak's (and initially Marina's red) unit; can call Guardian satellite strikes.

glossary.note: Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer

report.translator_summary: Conclusion of Operation 03 debriefing and two Preventer intelligence reports filed by Lady Une. Captain Sinapus refocuses the Albion's crew on pursuing the stolen Gundam Unit 2 to Africa. The first Preventer report notes that the two unknown units (Dunbine and Bastole) encountered off Tokyo Bay vanished without a trace, showing anomalous characteristics unlike any known military faction and suggesting possible extraterrestrial or extra-dimensional origins. The second Preventer report tracks sightings of the unidentified black unit (Buster Ark) attacking across North America, the Far East, and Tokyo Bay; despite striking visual resemblance to the prototype Gun Ark, UCE Headquarters confirms only one Gun Ark exists (on the Albion) and is questioning Chief Researcher Fidel Barkholz about the situation.
